activity.notes: Massinissa emerged from the Second Punic War as ruler of a unified Numidian kingdom in 202 BCE and remained king until his death in 148 BCE. ATLAS records the unified Kingdom of Numidia phase rather than earlier factional Massylian service.

sources.title: Masinissa — Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Masinissa as the ruler who unified Numidia after the Second Punic War and remained king until his death in 148 BCE.
